answer: Lock each identity's influence behind a lagoon of shared collateral: newcomers stake a small deposit into a pooled tide fund that only releases voting weight after surviving one full epoch of random peer challenges. A relic token — non-transferable proof of past verified work — gates how much weight the stake can carry. A sybil farmer must fund a fresh stake and survive the full challenge tide for every clone, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its relic.
